Zion Massage College is located in the beautiful Green Valley area of St. George Utah. The college offers an accredited 900 hour professional massage therapy program, which is focused on Eastern Bodywork and Deep/Structural based massage. The mission of ZMC is to educate well-trained, compassionate and knowledgeable massage therapy professionals with a commitment to the health and well-being of the community and to their clients. Visit www.zmc.edu for more info

In addition to the professional massage therapy program, ZMC offers continuing education opportunities for licensed massage therapy professionals such as, advanced courses in Thai Massage, Ashiatsu, Gua-Sha and Chinese Cupping Massage. ZMC encourages and supports life-long learning for its students, staff members and for the St. George community.

ZMC also offers free and low-cost Community Classes in Meditation, Qi-Gong, Yoga, Couples Thai Massage and Reflexology.
